acquirer.name: Angel Oak Financial Strategies Income Term Trust

listed_quote.quote: Angel Oak Financial Strategies Income Term Trust (NYSE: FINS) and Vivaldi Opportunities Fund (NYSE: VAM), each a closed-end fund, announced today

announcement.quote: Angel Oak and Vivaldi Closed-End Funds Announce Boards’ Approval of Proposed Merger

deals.notes: Special meeting first set for April 7, 2020, then the 2020-04-27 DEF 14A sets it for May 27, 2020 (reorganization of Vivaldi Opportunities Fund with and into the Fund). The N-14/A of 2020-04-29 still shows the merger as pending. The 2021 DEF 14A and 8-K excerpts (annual meeting items, a rights offering) say nothing about VAM. No excerpt states how the merger ended.
